D06_semantics: Absolute Oracle Ceiling / outer theoretical ruler only
candidate_future_value: candidate notional carried from current entry open to frozen H0 exit after future exit cost; censored candidates carried to cutoff mark
incumbent_hold_value: current quantity carried to frozen H0 structural exit after future exit cost; censored positions carried to cutoff mark
normal_action_in_full_reallocation: includes the candidate's canonical normal entry when it is already fundable, so replacement must beat that action rather than a zero-entry strawman
replacement_decision: replace only when projected local terminal wealth is strictly greater than the frozen normal action
sell_now_value: current open gross value less current exit cost
